children: Moderna, Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNA) surged after positive Phase III melanoma data for its T‑cell priming therapy and expanding oncology trials with Merck, while presenting upcoming clinical data and regulator talks, as analysts reassess ratings and the company pushes a five‑vaccine portfolio toward cash breakeven by 2028.
Moderna, Inc.: Positive Phase III Melanoma Results
: Moderna (MRNA) reported positive Phase III melanoma results for its T‑cell priming therapy and said related trials are continuing and expanding into lung, bladder and renal cancer indications.
Moderna, Inc.: Present Data, Regulators Consultations
: Moderna (MRNA) will present clinical data at a medical meeting and will consult regulators on potential filings after topline results—key near-term catalysts for traders.
: Analysts updated Moderna (MRNA) ratings and price targets: upgrades and downgrades noted; price targets range roughly $81–$180; consensus sits near Hold with average target about $91.
Moderna, Inc.: Five Approved Respiratory Vaccines
: Moderna (MRNA) now has five approved respiratory vaccines, including mFluSiva for seniors, a Europe-launched flu/COVID combo, and next‑gen COVID mNEXSPIKE, boosting portfolio contracting potential.
Moderna, Inc.: Shares Rise On Industry News
: Moderna (MRNA) surged ~8% to $158 after related industry news, up over 100% month-to-date as it advances cancer vaccine candidate intismeran autogene and nine Merck-partnered oncology trials.
: Moderna (MRNA) aims for cash breakeven by 2028 and forecasts up to 10% revenue growth, citing infectious-disease vaccine sales and an expanded five-vaccine approved portfolio.
